Synaptics S3320 touchscreen controller

Required properties:
- compatible: must be "synaptics,s3320"
- reg: I2C address of the controller
- interrupts: interrupt specifier for the controller interrupt
- interrupt-parent: phandle of the interrupt controller
- vcc_i2c_1v8-supply: phandle of the I/O supply regulator
- vdd_2v8-supply: phandle of the analog supply regulator
- synaptics,irq-gpio: interrupt GPIO specifier
- synaptics,reset-gpio: reset GPIO specifier
- synaptics,vdd-voltage: minimum and maximum I/O supply voltage in uV
- synaptics,avdd-voltage: minimum and maximum analog supply voltage in uV
- synaptics,vdd-current: I/O supply load in uA
- synaptics,avdd-current: analog supply load in uA
- synaptics,tx-rx-num: transmit and receive electrode counts
- synaptics,display-coords: display width and height
- pinctrl-names: must contain "pmx_ts_active" and "pmx_ts_suspend"
- pinctrl-0: active pin configuration
- pinctrl-1: suspend pin configuration

Optional properties:
- synaptics,1v8-gpio: GPIO controlling the I/O supply
- synaptics,enable2v8-gpio: GPIO controlling the analog supply
- synaptics,max-num-support: maximum number of simultaneous contacts
- synaptics,button-map: three Linux input key codes
- synaptics,panel-coords: panel width and height; defaults to 1080 by 1920
- oem,support_1080x2160_tp: controller is attached to a 1080 by 2160 panel
- oem,support_hw_poweroff: power the controller off during suspend

Example:

	touchscreen@20 {
		compatible = "synaptics,s3320";
		reg = <0x20>;
		interrupt-parent = <&tlmm>;
		interrupts = <125 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_LOW>;
		vcc_i2c_1v8-supply = <&pm8998_l6>;
		vdd_2v8-supply = <&pm8998_l28>;
		synaptics,irq-gpio = <&tlmm 125 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;
		synaptics,reset-gpio = <&tlmm 89 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
		synaptics,vdd-voltage = <1808000 1808000>;
		synaptics,avdd-voltage = <3008000 3008000>;
		synaptics,vdd-current = <40000>;
		synaptics,avdd-current = <20000>;
		synaptics,tx-rx-num = <17 30>;
		synaptics,display-coords = <1080 1920>;
		pinctrl-names = "pmx_ts_active", "pmx_ts_suspend";
		pinctrl-0 = <&ts_active>;
		pinctrl-1 = <&ts_int_suspend &ts_reset_suspend>;
	};
